name: Melody Bar & Grill
facts: Melody Bar & Grill, the closest bar to LAX, since 1952
9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045 (Westchester)
Rewards are free to join; earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases (before tip)
+100 points when you join, +250 once a year on your birthday
+100 points per friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit
One reward per member per day; a reward pass expires 10 minutes after it opens
Melody Approach is the free flying game: Campaign (10 levels) and Survival
Weekly boards reset every Monday; game prizes are in BETA and not on yet
Just Landed: 10% off your first order with a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours
Melody has its own points balance, separate from sister spot Nalu Vida
Free parking per Melody's website; about a 15-minute walk from LAX
suggested: What are the happy hour times?
How do I play Melody Approach?
Where are you and where do I park?

qa.a: Melody is a bar and grill close to LAX in Westchester, open since 1952. The app has the menu, sports scores, games, trivia and Melody Rewards.
9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045. Tap Directions in the app for a map.
Call (310) 670-1994, or tap the Call button in the app.
Melody's website lists Mon–Fri 11 AM to 1:30 AM and Sat–Sun 9 AM to 1:30 AM. Hours can vary, so call (310) 670-1994 to confirm late at night.
I don't have a kitchen closing time. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
Melody's website says parking is free, including a free lot for people picking up travelers. Ask staff if you're unsure where to park.
Yes. Melody's website says it's about a 15-minute walk from the LAX terminals, and the app says Melody is 5 minutes from LAX by car.
Happy hour is 3–6 daily.

qa.q: What are the happy hour deals?
qa.a: The app says happy hour is 3–6 daily. Melody's website lists $8 wells and $1 off draft beers, plus discounted bites. Ask your server for today's details.
Yes: Mon half off burgers 11–3, Tue $4 tacos and $6 margaritas, Thu half off sandwiches 11–3, Fri $3 sliders 11–3.
Half off burgers, 11–3.
Taco Tuesday: every taco is $4, and margaritas are $6.
Melody's website lists a Happy Hour Lunch 11–3 with the happy hour food menu, and karaoke Wednesday nights. Ask staff to confirm.
Half off sandwiches, 11–3.
$3 sliders, 11–3.
Melody's website lists weekend brunch Sat and Sun, 9 AM to 3 PM. The app doesn't show a brunch menu, so ask staff.
Every week: karaoke, live bands, DJs, trivia and every game on the TVs.
Melody's website lists karaoke on Wednesday nights from about 10 PM. Call to confirm.
Melody's website says most events, including happy hour and game watch parties, have no cover. I don't have a cover for late DJ nights, so ask staff.

qa.q: Can I watch the game at Melody?
qa.a: Yes, every game is on the TVs. The app also shows today's LA and California games with a Where to watch button.
I don't have a booking link. Call (310) 670-1994 to ask.
Melody's website says it hosts private events for about 10 to 150 guests. Call (310) 670-1994 for details.

qa.q: Do you do catering or delivery?
qa.a: Melody's website lists catering and DoorDash delivery, plus takeout. Call to ask about your order.

qa.q: Is there a discount for LAX workers?
qa.a: Melody's website lists 10% off the check for airline, TSA, terminal, hotel, rental car and shuttle workers with a badge. It's dine-in only and can't be combined with other promos.

qa.q: How do I join Melody Rewards?
qa.a: Tap the join button in the app. It's free, takes about 10 seconds and gives you a gold Melody Rewards card on your phone.
Yes, it's free to join. It's one account per person.

qa.q: Do I need to download an app?
qa.a: No download. It opens in your phone's browser, and you can add it to your home screen.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my home screen?
qa.a: Use your phone browser's Add to Home Screen option. On iPhone, nearby alerts need the app on your Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer).
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases (before tip). You also get bonuses for joining, your birthday, referrals and playing games.
10 points for every $1 you spend, before tip.

qa.q: How do I get points for a visit?
qa.a: Tap Add my visit in the app and snap your receipt, or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday). Once Melody's POS is connected, this will be automatic.

qa.q: Are there limits on claiming a visit?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check once, and up to $150 per check. Points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do points count on the tip?
qa.a: No. Points are earned on eligible purchases before tip.
I don't have the final list of what's excluded. Ask staff.
I don't have an expiry rule. Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff for details.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: +100 points once when you join.
Yes, +250 points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: Do I need ID for the birthday bonus?
qa.a: I don't have the rules for that. Ask staff.
Yes. You get +100 points for each friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.
A friend enters your code once when they join. It can't be changed later and you can't use your own. It doesn't stack with another reward on the same visit.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for turning on location?
qa.a: Yes. Turn on nearby alerts, and you get +100 points once if location and notifications were on when you opened the app on at least 3 different days over at least 7 days.

qa.q: Can the app track me in the background?
qa.a: No. It only reads your location while the app is open, and only if you turned it on. Your exact location stays on your phone.

qa.q: How do I turn off nearby alerts?
qa.a: Tap Turn off nearby alerts in the app, or switch off Location and Notifications for this site in your phone's Settings. Points you earned stay.

qa.q: What can I redeem my points for?
qa.a: 250 pts: free soft drink or Melody Fries. 500 pts: free starter (Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers). 1,000 pts: $10 off your check. 1,500 pts: free entrée (any Mac & Cheese or burrito).

qa.q: How many points for a free soft drink or fries?
qa.a: 250 points for a free soft drink or Melody Fries.

qa.q: How many points for a free starter?
qa.a: 500 points for a free Fried Green Beans, Avocado Toast or Chicken Pot Stickers.
1,000 points for $10 off your check.

qa.q: How many points for a free entrée?
qa.a: 1,500 points for any Mac & Cheese or burrito.
Melody can change point values and rewards with notice in the app. The rewards card in the app always shows your next reward.

qa.q: How do I use a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and show the live pass to your server, who applies it. Points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does a reward pass last?
qa.a: A pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens. Your next code comes on your next visit.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per visit and one prize per day (Los Angeles date), and rewards don't stack. A second prize shows Come back tomorrow.
No. Rewards are never free alcohol, have no cash value and can't be transferred.
The app doesn't list levels or tiers. Rewards are based on your points balance.

qa.q: Is my points balance shared with Nalu Vida?
qa.a: No. Melody has its own balance, and points don't move between restaurants.
It's your digital gold card in the app. It shows your card ID, points, next reward, a QR and this visit's code.

qa.q: Can I add the card to Apple or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Not yet. Wallet buttons aren't available right now, but your card lives in the app.
It's a free flying arcade game. Dogfight over LA in Campaign (10 levels) or last as long as you can in Survival.

qa.q: How do I control the plane?
qa.a: Drag anywhere on the game and the plane glides to your finger. Tap the ⚡ BOOST button for a speed boost and grab the hourglass for slow-mo.
It's 10 levels of about 45 seconds each over a SoCal route, each a bit harder, with six boss fights (levels 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 10), then a landing at LAX. It ends with a landing back at LAX.
There's no finish line. The game keeps getting harder until your plane goes down, and your time survived is your score.

qa.q: How do I score and stay alive?
qa.a: Shoot down jets, UFOs, choppers and bosses, dodge their fire (attacks are warned first), and catch Melody's food and music notes. Three hits and your plane goes down.

qa.q: When do the guns turn on?
qa.a: Guns go live about 20 seconds into a flight. Beating levels and bosses (or flying longer in Survival) unlocks stronger guns, and catching ammo crates refills ammo.
Yes. Pause and tap the ⚔️ button to switch to a calm flight with no combat.

qa.q: Is the game free? How often can I play?
qa.a: It's free, with or without an account, and no purchase is needed. I don't see a daily limit on flights.
Yes, two boards: Campaign (ranked by score) and Survival (longest time survived). Both reset every Monday. Practice and test flights don't count.

qa.q: How do I post my score?
qa.a: At the end of a flight, tap Post my score to put it on the board.

qa.q: What does the weekly winner get?
qa.a: Once prizes switch on, the top player on each weekly board may win the prize shown in the game, currently Free Melody Fries. For now it's bragging rights only (BETA).
Boards reset every Monday, but game prizes are still in BETA. I don't have details on how winners are picked or contacted, so ask staff.

qa.q: Do I get points for playing the game?
qa.a: Not yet. When game rewards switch on, you get 1 point per 100 score, with a max of 50 game points a day.
Game rewards are switched off for now. The game and weekly boards are live, but no prizes or game points are given yet.

qa.q: Do cheats count on the board?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.
It's live LA scores, trivia, sports trivia, Truth or Dare and the daily Melody Word. Play solo or pass the phone around the table.
Pick a category, then answer questions with 4 choices against a timer. Faster right answers score more. You can play solo or pass the phone with 2–6 players.
Pick a favorite LA or California team for a 10-question Fan Test and a 1–5 star Fan Rating, or play all LA sports. It's the same timer format as Trivia.
It's one daily 5-letter word, the same for everyone that day. You get 6 guesses and up to 2 hints, and a new word comes every day at midnight LA time.
It's a word scramble. Unscramble as many words as you can before time runs out, with a few skips.
A table game for 1–6 players with light truths and fun dares. Dares never involve drinking, and anyone can pass. It's just for fun, no points.

qa.q: Do trivia and word games earn points?
qa.a: Not until game rewards switch on. Then Trivia and Sports Trivia give 1 point per 2 right answers (up to 5 a round), Melody Mix 1 per 2 words (up to 3), and Melody Word 3 points (2 with 1 hint, 1 with 2). Max 10 a day from these games.
Free picks on today's games with no money or wagers. Once game rewards are on, a right pick made before the game starts earns 2 points, up to 6 a day. Picks lock when the game starts.

qa.q: Does the app show live scores?
qa.a: Yes, today's LA and California games from ESPN with scores and a Where to watch button. It's for information only, not streams.
A free game per NFL or college game. Every member can get one free square by tapping Get my free square. Staff can add extra squares with a purchase. No entry fee.

qa.q: When are Squares numbers drawn and who wins?
qa.a: Entries close at kickoff, then the row and column numbers (0–9) are drawn at random. The last digit of each team's score picks the winner at the end of Q1, halftime, Q3 and the final.

Prizes are set for each board and shown on it before you play: food, merch, % off the check, a free non-alcoholic drink, or % off a drink (21+, ID). No cash or gift cards. Claim at Melody with your Rewards card.

qa.q: What is the Just Landed deal?
qa.a: 10% off your first order today when you show a boarding pass from a flight that landed at LAX in the last 24 hours.

qa.q: Can I combine Just Landed with other offers?
qa.a: No. It's one per guest per day and can't be combined with other offers.

qa.q: How do I order from the table?
qa.a: Scan the table code, or pick Bar, Patio, To go or your table number in the app. Add items and tap Send my order. If you scanned a table code, your table is already picked.
Pay your server or bartender like normal. You still earn points on every check.

qa.q: What happens with a to-go order?
qa.a: Pick To go, send your order, and the app says it will text you when it's ready.
Starters, Mac & Cheese, a Melody Burger, Fries, Soups, and Tacos & Burritos, plus drinks. Browse them in the app's Menu tab.

qa.q: What are your Mac & Cheese options?
qa.a: Lobster ($21.50), Melody Burger ($19.25), Chicken Parmesan ($18.25), Bacon Cheddar & Jalapeño ($17.25), Parmesan & Mushroom ($17.25) and House Mac ($15).
Shrimp ($16), Salmon ($16), Carnitas ($14), Chicken ($13), Avocado ($13) and Beyond ($14), 2 tacos each. Tuesdays every taco is $4.

Lemon Pepper Wings, Avocado Toast, BBQ Rib Grilled Cheese Bites, Chicken Strips & Fries, Chicken Pot Stickers, Fried Green Beans, Fried Shrimp, Jalapeno Calamari, Lettuce Wraps and Baby Back Ribs & Fries. Prices are in the app.
The app lists the Melody Burger ($19.25): Angus beef on a pretzel bun with caramelized onions, Gorgonzola, bacon, spinach and BBQ sauce, with fries. Mondays are half off burgers 11–3.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian or vegan options?
qa.a: The app shows Beyond Tacos, Avocado Tacos, Bean & Cheese Burrito and others. Ask your server about ingredients. For allergies, check with staff.

qa.q: What drinks are on the menu?
qa.a: Margaritas, Paloma, Old Fashioned, Moscow Mule, Espresso Martini, Long Island, Michelada, draft beer, mimosa, shots and a bucket of beers. Drink prices in the app are previews until Melody confirms them.
The app shows House Margarita at $12 (preview price), and $6 on Tuesdays. Confirm with your server.

qa.q: Are the prices in the app final?
qa.a: Food prices come from Melody's menu. Drink prices are previews until Melody confirms them, so your server has the final price.

qa.q: What languages does the app support?
qa.a: The app has 12 languages.
Yes, the games have a kid mode that hides adult-themed games. Ask staff if you have questions.
Melody's website says it hosts kids' birthday parties and is family-friendly by day. I don't have an evening or late-night age policy, so call (310) 670-1994.
Yes. Patio is an option when you order, and Melody's website mentions a string-lit outdoor patio.
I don't have a pet policy. Please ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
I don't have a dress code listed. Ask staff or call (310) 670-1994.
It's Melody's sister spot at Venice Pier. Ride the Nalu in the app to earn Nalu Vida points, which are a separate balance from Melody.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 670-1994.

qa.q: What does the app collect about me?
qa.a: When you open the app (at most once every 10 minutes) it records the time, a short device summary, a random phone ID and your member ID if you joined. Approximate location (about 1 km) only if you turned location on. It's never sold and not used for ads.
Only Melody's owner and SousShift AI, and it's never sold or used for ads. It's used for rewards limits, fraud prevention and visit stats.
